resale_co.name: Certificate for Change in Occupancy or Ownership (Resale/Rental Certificate)
requirements: Smoke alarms on every level and outside each sleeping area: 10-year sealed battery alarms, or hardwired where required
Basement alarm at the bottom of the stairwell on the ceiling (not between joists); hallway alarms close to all bedrooms
Smoke alarms less than 10 years old (or not past the maker's expiration date) and working
Hardwired smoke alarms required by the building code cannot be replaced with battery alarms
Homes with a monitored low-voltage fire alarm system: have it tested by the alarm company before the inspection and bring the certification
CO alarm in the hallway close to all bedrooms, less than 10 years old, UL listed and working

Fire extinguisher rated 2A-10B:C, no more than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress, top no more than 5 feet above the floor, on the maker's bracket, not in a closet or behind a door; leave the manual for the new occupant (March 2025 checklist)
House numbers at least 3 inches, contrasting, permanently fixed to the house and visible from the street
No open Springfield Township construction permits; all permitted work finalized and passed
Statement from the Tax Collector submitted with the application; no certificate is issued if Township real estate taxes are due (town code Chapter 66)

fees.label: Each additional inspection after the first two
fees.quote: Two inspections are included. All additional inspections will be charged a $65.00 fee per inspection.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Resale/Rental Application (Rev. Mar 2025) from the Construction Office resources, check "Sale", sign it, and submit it with a check or money order for $150.00 payable to "Springfield Township" to the Construction Office, 2159 Jacksonville-Jobstown Road, Jobstown, NJ 08041. The town code (Chapter 66) also asks for a written request giving the date the buyer takes occupancy and the buyer's name, plus a statement from the Tax Collector. The fee is non-refundable. Inspection results and the certificate are sent by email.

resale_co.notes: The leads file pointed to springfield-nj.us, which is Springfield Township in Union County; the Burlington County township site is www.springfieldtownshipnj.org (Jobstown). The township code on ecode360 (SP0427, legislation through 07-08-2026) was read in full this round through its print view. Chapter 66, Certificates for Change in Occupancy or Ownership (§66-1), now holds the resale rule: anyone selling an R-3/R-4/R-5 dwelling must ask the Construction Code Official for an inspection, get a CSACMAPFEC (smoke, CO and extinguisher certificate), meet the house numbering rules, have open permits closed out, and show the Tax Collector's statement that taxes are paid. The old §150-2 that the township's March 2025 fee sheet still cites was repealed 12-10-2025 by Ord. No. 2025-09 (the rule moved to Chapter 66). Fees: the township fee sheet and application (March 2025) say $150.00 with two inspections included and $65.00 for each additional inspection. The code fee schedule (§91-7, Housing inspection fees, last amended 2012) lists Sale of property $150 and Reinspection $50. The $150 matches; the reinspection amount differs ($65 on the form, $50 in the code), so confirm with the office. The township's forms open through a document viewer: the resource-list address (/api/blob/viewBlob?rf=t&i=...) returns the PDF only when the request carries a township page as the Referer (a known site quirk, not a change); without it an automated fetch gets the viewer page, so the weekly script cannot match these quotes. Both PDFs were re-read on 2026-10-13 with a Referer header and are unchanged (created March 25, 2025). Staff names and titles come from the township's staff widget data (app.membershipware.com) shown on the Construction Office page; the site spells the title "Construction Offical". Other contact: Kathy Warnebold, Technical Assistant to the Construction Official, construction@springfieldtownshipnj.org, 609-723-2464 (Tuesday to Thursday 8:00AM to 1:00PM). The same application covers rentals; for rentals built before 1978 a lead-safe certificate is also required (rental only).

requirements: 10-year sealed battery smoke alarms (or hardwired as required) on every level and near all bedrooms; alarms under 10 years old
Hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA is the fire code enforcing agency for Springfield Township (LEA registry code S), but DCA's state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) does not mark Springfield Twp 'SC' (smoke certs) and the DCA smoke certificate portal data flags SPRINGFIELD TWP (B) as smoke-certificate exempt. The state fire directory (three fire company pages) names the Springfield Twp Construction Office, PO Box 119, Jobstown, (609) 723-2464, for smoke detector compliance. Town code §66-1A(2) requires the CSACMAPFEC as part of the change of occupancy certificate. The township's March 2025 checklist still lists a portable fire extinguisher (2A-10B:C, no more than 10 lb, within 10 feet of the kitchen), as does the town code wording; state law P.L.2025, c.19 dropped the extinguisher from the state sale certificate in February 2025, so confirm with the office.

other_items.label: Tax Collector statement
other_items.detail: A statement from the Tax Collector must go in with the application; no certificate for change in occupancy or ownership is issued if Township real estate taxes are due and owing (town code §66-1A(1)).

other_items.label: Open construction permits closed
other_items.detail: No outstanding Springfield Township construction permits; all permitted work must be finalized and passed before the resale inspection passes.

other_items.label: Rental registration deactivated
other_items.detail: If the property was a rental, the landlord registration is deactivated on the resale application.

open_questions: Lead time before closing and certificate validity are not published.

Confirm the extinguisher is still required given P.L.2025, c.19; the March 2025 checklist and Chapter 66 still name it.
